_about: Small derived facts for rank_estimate.py. Every number has a source id from SOURCE.txt. Read 2026-11-27 (sanjesh.org itself refused automated fetches, so these are news-agency relays of Sanjesh announcements).

exam_weights._source: S1 (official 1402 weights relayed by Mehr, republished by gama.ir) + S2 (Mehr 4 Mehr 1402: 1403 keeps the 1402 titles and coefficients). 1404 and 1405: no dated primary source found; ASSUMED unchanged.

sabeqe_share._source: 1403: S2 · 1404: S3 · 1405: S4, S5. 1405 grade split (11th 17% + 12th 43%, تأثیر قطعی) is disputed in other reports (S6, S7); the 60/40 split is not.

participants._source: 1403 round 2 sat: S8 · 1404 round 2 registered: S9 (riazi reconstructed from a garbled figure) · 1405 single round, registered (not sat): S10. 1403 and 1404 had two rounds each.

general_subjects: Removed from the exam since 1402; they count only through school records (S2).
